Subject: Your ohmail password was used and the second step failed

ohmail.

Your password was used, and the second step failed.

Somebody signed in to your ohmail account with your password and then failed the second step several times.

If that was you, there is nothing to do.

If it was not, somebody knows your password, and your second factor stopped them. Open ohmail yourself and check Settings › Devices (https://ohmail.app/settings/devices). Then write to support@ohmail.app, and we help you secure the account.

Time: 26 September 2026, 12:00 UTC

We never ask you for a code, a password or a recovery code by mail.
